newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen halts trading due to malfunction.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen halts trading due to malfunction.

text.p: The Shenzhen stock exchange had to halt trading on Thursday afternoon due to a breakdown in its telecommunication system, an exchange spokesman said.
"The problem occurred at noon after the morning session ended and our engineers are trying their best to check and fix the system," the spokesman said.
"It's not yet known whether it can be fixed today," he added.
There was no trading on Thursday in the city's B share market in line with the closure of the Hong Kong bourse because of the Christmas holiday. Trading will resume on Friday.

Shenzhen's A share index rose 6.26 points or 2.04 percent to 312.33 at midday on Thursday on turnover of 3.27 billion yuan, with speculative buying targeting cheap stocks that had posted heavy losses over the past few sessions, brokers said.
